# CLI reference

## `redact`

```text
Keep secrets, names, and sensitive information out of what AI sees

Usage: redact [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  scan         Read text on stdin and write it back with sensitive parts as placeholders
  packs        List the packs and word lists that load, and where each comes from
  config       Show the config files and what they load
  completions  Print a shell completion script, e.g. `redact completions zsh`
  init         Print shell setup: completions plus `redacted <cmd>`, which runs a
               command and masks its output, stderr included, keeping its exit status.
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -f, --file <PATH>
          Also load this pack (.toml) or word list (.txt). Repeatable

      --only-files
          Load only --file: skip the built-in packs and everything in ~/.config/redact

  -c, --config <PATH>
          Use this config file instead of ~/.config/redact/config.toml
          
          [env: REDACT_CONFIG=]

      --env-file <PATH>
          Also hide every value in this dotenv file (`.env`). Repeatable

      --command <COMMAND>
          The command whose output this is, for `[[override]] command = "..."`
          
          [env: REDACT_COMMAND=]

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## `redact scan`

```text
Read text on stdin and write it back with sensitive parts as placeholders

Usage: scan [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -f, --file <PATH>
          Also load this pack (.toml) or word list (.txt). Repeatable

      --json
          Print the parts to hide as JSON byte spans instead of the masked text

      --explain
          Also say on stderr which rule hid each part (never the value)

      --only-files
          Load only --file: skip the built-in packs and everything in ~/.config/redact

  -c, --config <PATH>
          Use this config file instead of ~/.config/redact/config.toml
          
          [env: REDACT_CONFIG=]

      --env-file <PATH>
          Also hide every value in this dotenv file (`.env`). Repeatable

      --command <COMMAND>
          The command whose output this is, for `[[override]] command = "..."`
          
          [env: REDACT_COMMAND=]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `redact config`

```text
Show the config files and what they load

Usage: config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  ls    List every file that loads, in load order, and what imported it

  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
```

## `redact completions`

```text
Print a shell completion script, e.g. `redact completions zsh`

Usage: completions [OPTIONS] <SHELL>

Arguments:
  <SHELL>
          [possible values: bash, elvish, fish, powershell, zsh]

Options:
  -f, --file <PATH>
          Also load this pack (.toml) or word list (.txt). Repeatable

          Use this config file instead of ~/.config/redact/config.toml

      --env-file <PATH>
          Also hide every value in this dotenv file (`.env`). Repeatable

      --command <COMMAND>
          The command whose output this is, for `[[override]] command = "..."`
          
          [env: REDACT_COMMAND=]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `redact init`

```text
Print shell setup: completions plus `redacted <cmd>`, which runs a
command and masks its output, stderr included, keeping its exit status.

Add one line to your shell's startup file:

  bash  ~/.bashrc                        eval "$(redact init bash)"
  zsh   ~/.zshrc                         eval "$(redact init zsh)"
  fish  ~/.config/fish/config.fish       redact init fish | source
  pwsh  $PROFILE                         Invoke-Expression (& redact init powershell | Out-String)
  elvish ~/.config/elvish/rc.elv         eval (redact init elvish | slurp)

Usage: init [OPTIONS] <SHELL>

Arguments:
  <SHELL>
          [possible values: bash, elvish, fish, powershell, zsh]

Options:
  -f, --file <PATH>
          Also load this pack (.toml) or word list (.txt). Repeatable

      --only-files
          Load only --file: skip the built-in packs and everything in ~/.config/redact

  -c, --config <PATH>
          Use this config file instead of ~/.config/redact/config.toml
          
          [env: REDACT_CONFIG=]

      --env-file <PATH>
          Also hide every value in this dotenv file (`.env`). Repeatable

      --command <COMMAND>
          The command whose output this is, for `[[override]] command = "..."`
          
          [env: REDACT_COMMAND=]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
